name: Subconscious scheduler arbiter — daily synthesis of proposers
notes: Runs AFTER the three proposers (window 05:30 to give them time to finish at 05:00–05:30). Reads intention.* pods minted today + household_calendar (hard constraint) and emits ONE plan.weekly_schedule pod with is_anchor flags. Hard conflicts surface as dayflow tickets; deduplicates near-identical proposals from different proposers.
